answer: Clone farms flood attest slots because a new key is almost free. Each applicant reserves one 16-minute anvil slot at a public forge on a named ridge and cold-stamps a serialized jade coupon with H(pubkey||coupon_id||slot). Cost is 62 locked units plus exclusive anvil time. Peers re-hash the coupon face against the slot map and drop any coupon whose fuel invoice or refund address already appears on another live anvil. A missed slot or assay below 80 hardness burns 20 units and cools the key for five epochs; a reused coupon-id or a second miss empties the lock and bars the key for eleven epochs.
